proof_test.source:
import pytest

def test_infinite_solution_detection():
    from sympy.abc import x, y
    from sympy.solvers.polysys import solve_poly_system

    # First case: system (x - 1,) with variables x, y -> should raise NotImplementedError
    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
        solve_poly_system((x - 1,), x, y)

    # Second case: system (y - 1,) with variables x, y -> should also raise NotImplementedError
    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
        solve_poly_system((y - 1,), x, y)
